identification: (1) Yemeni/Omani-style necklace of white metal beads (large fluted/ribbed central bead, granulated round beads, bicone and elongated beads, rosette spacers) alternating with round red carnelian or glass beads, on a white metal chain with ring clasp; 20th-century tourist/trade type, silver content unknown, probably low-grade silver or base metal. (2) Gilt metal filigree 'chain mesh' panel made of wire scroll links hung with small round gilt sequin discs, centre filigree scrolls; broken, with a bag of loose links/discs. Looks like brass or gilt base metal costume work (Middle Eastern/Indian), not gold.
